transcript.text: I need to flag a music clearance issue. I confirmed with the publisher this morning that the popular song we've been using is only licensed for a 15-second excerpt in unpaid editorial posts — it cannot be used in a paid digital trailer. The good news is the publisher has approved an alternative: we can use the original-score cue 'Low Tide Pulse.' I haven't entered the revised license result in the campaign tracker yet, but I wanted to get this on the table now so we can adjust the package accordingly.

Additionally, the placement requires the exact on-screen warning text 'Violence and mature themes.' to appear in the teaser.
